when_to_use: radio-friendly smooth jazz, vocal-centric sax/guitar lead, smooth slash chord, full pop-verse-chorus form, 65-115 BPM

defaults.feel: straight, ultra-precise 16ths, no swing, expression carried by lead phrasing not timing

signature_moves: smooth slash chord: Fmaj7/G or Dm7/G in place of a plain G7
pedal bass: Cmaj9 -> Dm7/C -> Fmaj7/C -> Cmaj9
stepwise bass descent: Cmaj9 -> G/B -> Am11 -> C/G -> Fmaj7
sub-V backdoor resolution: Bbmaj7/C -> Fmaj7/G -> Cmaj9
cadence_options: pre-chorus lift into the smooth slash chord before the chorus downbeat
chorus hook resolves cleanly to tonic maj9
avoid: a plain dominant 7th where a 9sus4 or smooth slash chord would be smoother
altered or bluesy dissonance - keep consonant and easy on the ear

hook_archetypes.name: vocal-centric-hook
hook_archetypes.rhythm: a clear singable 2-4 bar phrase with deliberate rests
hook_archetypes.contour: scoop or bend into target note, controlled vibrato only at the tail
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Chorus, sax or guitar in a higher register than verse

hook_archetypes.name: ad-lib-outro-figure
hook_archetypes.rhythm: loose vocal-style ad-libs around tonic, not scalar improvisation
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Outro over the repeating chorus hook

verse.note_lengths: relaxed lower-register phrases with 1-2 bar rests
verse.placement: on grid; expression comes from tone and ornaments

chorus.placement: on grid with controlled vibrato at note tails

solo.note_lengths: structured and singable, avoiding dense runs

drum_skeleton.low_energy: soft cross-stick backbeat, velocity-layered straight 16th hi-hat, steady shaker
drum_skeleton.mid_energy: kick adds light R&B syncopation, hi-hat dynamics widen, shaker stays steady
drum_skeleton.high_energy: chorus switches to layered full snare and thicker pad, remaining straight and precise

arrangement_defaults.layout_rules: intro uses guitar or e-piano over pad; verse brings R&B groove and lower-register lead; pre-chorus adds slash-chord tension; chorus lifts lead register, snare timbre, and pad thickness; bridge or solo stays singable; outro repeats chorus hook under fading vocal-style ad-libs

anti_boredom_rules: melody leaves 1-2 bar rests between phrases
chorus audibly lifts through register, snare timbre, and harmonic thickness
use a smooth slash chord at least once per form pass

bass_behavior.role: legato supporting counterline under a vocal-style lead
bass_behavior.rhythmic_relationship: lands precisely with kick while using stepwise connective motion
bass_behavior.density: medium and continuous without becoming a riff focus
bass_behavior.articulation: smooth fretless-style sustain and controlled slides

groove_intent.kick: light syncopation supporting slash-chord bass motion
groove_intent.snare: cross-stick in verses, layered full snare in choruses
groove_intent.ensemble_relationship: rhythm section remains precise while lead carries expression through bends and vibrato

distinguishing_traits: lead melody and timbral chorus lift are primary
consonant slash-chord harmony over a polished precise pocket

engine belum punya vibe preset untuk gaya ini di VIBE_PRESETS
